turns.replyText:
What's your return and refund policy?
Our return and refund policy is designed to make the process as straightforward as possible:
Returns:
You have 21 days from the date of delivery to return your items.
Items must be in their original condition – unworn, unwashed, and with tags still attached. Footwear must not have been worn outdoors.
For hygiene reasons, boxers can only be returned if they are unworn, unwashed, and in their original packaging with seals intact.
If your purchase was made in one of our physical stores, returns must be completed in-store within the same 21-day window.
Process:
Register your return through our returns portal.
Post the item(s) back to us within 5 days of registering the return.
Once your return arrives at our warehouse, we aim to process it within 10 days.
After approval, your refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. You’ll receive an email confirmation once the refund has been processed.
Refunds:
If you paid using a gift card, the refund will be issued back to the same gift card.
For split payments, refunds will first be applied to the gift card portion.
If you requested an exchange but the item is out of stock, a refund will be issued instead, and you’ll be notified by email.
Important Notes:
Until your return reaches our warehouse, the items remain your responsibility. Please ensure the parcel is securely packaged and retain proof of postage.
If you use a courier option provided through our returns portal and the parcel does not arrive, we may need time to investigate with the courier.
If you choose your own return method, any investigation would need to be raised directly with that courier.
For full details, you can view our returns policy here. If you have further questions, feel free to ask!
